fact_text: Kohat Cement declared Q1 FY26 earnings of PKR 3.20 per share, up about 25% quarter on quarter.

fact_text: Kohat Cement's Q1 FY26 net sales rose about 18% to PKR 10.3 billion.

fact_text: Kohat Cement's gross margin rose 2.7 percentage points to 33.9% in Q1 FY26.

fact_text: Kohat Cement's other income rose about 13% quarter on quarter to PKR 1.47 billion in Q1 FY26, partly from booking a gain on equity investments.

fact_text: Kohat Cement's gross margin was about 31% in Q4 FY25, which the presenter linked to a one-off inventory adjustment that depressed that quarter's margin.

fact_text: Kohat Cement's cash and cash equivalents rose to about PKR 33 billion from about PKR 26 billion, reflecting free cash flow the company generated.

fact_text: Cement dispatch figures for October and November 2025 were already out and strong, so the presenter expected Q2 FY26 profitability to be decent for Kohat Cement and other cement makers.

fact_text: Kohat Cement has not paid a dividend for many years, even though it generates surplus cash flow every quarter and every year, which the presenter said raises the question of how it will deploy its cash.

fact_text: Kohat Cement is investing in solar power to cut its energy costs, and the presenter thought it may be looking at acquisitions, possibly including the PIA privatisation.

fact_text: Kohat Cement is doubling its solar capacity from 15 MW to about 28-30 MW, expected to come online by the end of FY26 or in Q1 FY27.

fact_text: The presenter estimated the solar expansion adds about PKR 1 billion of earnings, roughly PKR 1 per share.

fact_text: The presenter said full-year FY26 earnings for Kohat Cement could reach about PKR 12.5 to 13 per share, based on Q1 FY26 earnings of PKR 3.20 and better volumes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of KOHC, PPL, & ASTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-03)

fact_text: Kohat Cement traded at about 8.4 times earnings, falling to about 7 times on FY27 earnings, according to the presenter's valuation view.

fact_text: A deferment of LNG cargoes from Qatar means more domestic gas is available to the system, which management expects to lift Pakistan Petroleum's gas revenue contribution.

fact_text: Amreli Steels restructured about PKR 11 billion of its roughly PKR 17 billion short-term loans, within total debt of about PKR 20 billion, at a markup agreed with lenders.

fact_text: Under the restructuring, Amreli Steels makes no principal or markup payments for three years, through FY27, with repayments running about seven years from FY28.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of KOHC, PPL, & ASTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-03)

fact_text: The presenter expected Amreli Steels to stay loss-making in FY26 and to recover gradually, with profitability depending on sales growth and whether it can cover its high financing and admin costs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of KOHC, PPL, & ASTL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-03)

fact_text: Amreli Steels' market share, once about 7-8%, had fallen substantially by 2025-12-03, the presenter said.
